name: translations-mcp
description: Translations MCP server for eRegistrations — context-aware translation of BPA services (field labels, tooltips, DS system strings, form structure, grids), plus one-command recovery from missing translation bootstrap via translation_global_status / translation_global_reload. Requires bpa-mcp plugin for authentication. Includes direct GTS catalogue tools (gts_translations / gts_update_batch) and the /translations-mcp:gts command for checking and upserting keys that the instance-side sync cannot fix.
